explainer_content.short_definition: Lo-fi, chill, and study music where beat texture and platform mood function matter more than traditional scene identity.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Nujabes and J Dilla provide instrumental hip-hop lineage, while Lo-fi Girl and chill/study streams show the algorithmic mood-listening form.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It captures a modern listening behavior: music chosen to sustain attention, calm, or ambience rather than foreground fandom.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The route is partly musical and partly behavioral; the same beat can be evidence because of how it is used.
